questions.question: What was the main source of income for the old crofter at the time the peddler visited him?
Why did the peddler return to the crofter’s cottage after saying goodbye?
What does the peddler’s idea of the world being a “rattrap” symbolize?
options: His cynical view of life and temptation
questions.explanation: His cynical view of life and temptation

questions.question: Which of the following statements is/are TRUE? I. The crofter was a lonely man happy to ﬁnd someone to talk to. II. The peddler played cards and smoked with the crofter. III. The crofter worked at the iron mill with the blacksmiths.

Which statements about the peddler are CORRECT? I. He made and sold rattraps from materials he begged for. II. He was welcomed by everyone during his travels. III. He believed the world tricked people like a rattrap.
Why does the forest feel like a “prison” to the peddler after stealing the money?
options: He is afraid of wild animals
His guilt and fear manifest as entrapment
questions.explanation: His guilt and fear manifest as entrapment
